system_prompt_style.note: Prompt from LLM_PROMPTS plus date and user LTM substitution; line number approximate from excerpt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Retrieves the HTML DOM of the active page based on the specified content type.
env_context_strategy.note: Agent senses the page via get_dom_with_content_type/geturl skills.

context_compaction.note: No history processor code in the evidence bundle (truncated); README TODO mentions planned history trimming. DOM distillation is observation shaping, not history compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: we use the DOM Accessibility Tree rather than the regular HTML DOM
observation_format.note: text_only returns text; input_fields/all_fields return compact JSON derived from the accessibility tree.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: python functions that are described to the LLM for function calling

tool_count.note: Skill registration list in browser_nav_agent.py is truncated and planner agent file not shown; at least openurl, get_dom_with_content_type, click, geturl, bulk_enter_text visible, plus imported entertext, press_key_combination, extract_text_from_pdf, pause_flow.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: We chose to use skills that map to what humans learn about the web browser rather than allow the LLM to write code as it pleases.
edit_primitive.note: Browser domain; no file-editing tool in the skills registry.

tool_schema_source.note: Descriptions hand-written in prompts.py; AutoGen derives parameter schema from signatures, so auto_generated elements also present.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file or grep results in the bundle.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
the planner decom-
poses the task into a sequence of steps that need to be executed.
loop_primitives.note: Planner delegates steps to a nested browser-nav ReAct-style chat.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: It breaks down the user task into a sequence of sub tasks and delegates them one at a time to the browser navigation agent.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Browser navigation agent is implemented as a nested chat that is freshly instantiated by the Planner for each run
multi_agent_topology.note: README says two agents; file tree contains high_level_planner_agent.py.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Browser navigation agent is implemented as a nested chat that is freshly instantiated by the Planner for each run

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Specifies whether to allow the planner agent to get user input or not.
human_in_loop.note: Default PLANNER_USER_INPUT_SKILL_ENABLED=false; opt-in get_user_input for clarification (closest on_plan/configurable). pause_flow skill also imported.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
return a summary of actions it took to perform the
task

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Fills the form using information from memory defined in user preferences.txt
long_term_memory.note: Static user LTM via ae/core/memory/static_ltm.py get_user_ltm injected in system prompt; not written by agent.

self_verification.note: Change observation is action feedback, not verification; planner prompted to verify (self_critique-ish) but prompt text not in bundle.

rollback.note: Paper describes planner backtracking to previous URLs as plan steps, not a rollback mechanism.

cost_controls.note: Task caching is a TODO; per-agent model configs selectable but not routing.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Agent-E is an agent based system that aims to automate actions on the user's computer.
execution_isolation.note: Local Playwright/Chrome browser on host; closest value.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Agent-E operates in a real-world web environment

permission_model.evidence_quote: We see the use of configured skills to be safer and more predictable in its outcomes.
permission_model.note: Only registered skills execute; no approval gate.

tracing.evidence_quote: Set to `json` or `text` (Default: `text`). Specifies the format for logging messages.
tracing.note: Chat logs saved to file by default.

target_domain.evidence_quote: At the moment it focuses on automation within the browser.

open_source.evidence_quote: Our code is available at https://github.com/EmergenceAI/Agent-E
open_source.note: LICENSE.txt present but contents not in bundle.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Agent-E supports the use of open-source models through LiteLLM and Ollama.

first_release_date.note: No tag/first-commit info in bundle; paper v1 date fallback.
